title: Novelty Collision Report
description: IDEATE-stage gate verdict artifact (novelty-collision-upgrade). Output of tools/novelty_collision.build_collision_verdict, written by operate.modes._shared.run_collision_gate BEFORE the /idea-bet menu. EVIDENCE-NOT-SCORE discipline: this is the ONE novelty channel allowed to CUT an idea, and only on a FACT — a specific paper that PASSED citation_existence (exists in the world) AND demonstrably did the same method×problem AND (by default) actually ran/implemented it. A novelty SCORE still never cuts (that stays idea_grounding's SCORE-ONLY job). A claimed collision whose paper is nonexistent / unconfirmable degrades to UNVERIFIED, never DEAD — the expensive error is killing a good idea, so absence of proof is never proof. Every input idea appears exactly once; cuts are reported (not hidden) so the director can override.

ideas.description: One verdict per input idea, in input order. Every menu idea appears exactly once — none dropped.

verdict.description: DEAD = existence-verified prior art did this method×problem (and ran it, by default) -> cut. WHITE_SPACE = exists on a different application/problem or proposed-only -> keep + flag (publishable). CLEAR = no collision found within coverage -> keep (not 'proven novel'). UNVERIFIED = retrieval ungrounded or the collider could not be existence-verified -> keep + loudly flag.

cut.description: True iff this idea is removed from the /idea-bet menu. Only ever True for DEAD, and only when policy.hard_block is True. CLEAR / WHITE_SPACE / UNVERIFIED are never cut.

colliding_papers.description: The papers the verdict rests on (may be []). 'existence' carries the citation_existence state for the ref (the fact-check the cut depends on).

ref.description: The citation the worker named (existence-checked by the gate). May be empty only if the worker omitted it.

existence.description: The citation_existence state for this ref. Real states are 'verified' / 'not_found' / 'lookup_error' / 'skipped'; the design aliases EXISTS / NONEXISTENT / UNKNOWN are also accepted. A DEAD cut requires 'verified' (or 'EXISTS').

experimentally_validated.description: Whether the colliding paper actually ran / implemented the method (carried through from the worker finding / ledger row).

reason.description: Human-readable justification for the verdict (and, for UNVERIFIED, why no cut was made).

source.description: worker = decided from this run's collision findings; ledger = pre-matched to the known-prior-art ledger (already cut in a prior run).

hard_block.description: Director default True: a DEAD idea is cut from the menu. False = flag-only (keep, still label DEAD).

cut_requires_experiments.description: True (default): a DEAD verdict additionally requires the colliding paper to have actually run/implemented it; proposed-only collisions become WHITE_SPACE.

policy.description: The knobs applied this run (profile-tunable; defaults are director-set).

cut_ids.description: idea_ids with cut == True (input order). These are removed from the /idea-bet menu and reported under cut_for_prior_art.

survivors.description: idea_ids with cut == False (input order). Only these reach build_idea_backlog / the /idea-bet menu.

retrieval_grounded.description: False when no retrieval records existed this run: every non-ledger idea is UNVERIFIED and nothing is cut. The orchestrator must loudly tell the director novelty was NOT verified (mandatory-check honesty).

evidence_ref.description: Pointer(s) to the collision bundle the verdict was derived from (e.g. ['inbox/COLLISION.bundle.json']).
